overview: They drive the biggest trucks on earth along the toughest roads and loneliest highways in the world. They are Australia's Outback Truckers, men and women in monster rigs, on marathon runs, through some of the most inhospitable terrain on the planet. Out here only one thing matters, getting there and back alive!
title: Outback Truckers

overview: The action of the action-packed film takes place around an auto track. The story begins with the murder of the director of the racing team "Favorite" Fedor Golovin, who is the leader of the last competitions. This death means the death of the team - without serious financial support, its continued existence is questionable. The murder was organized by a criminal structure, which, controlling the results of car racing, controls the sweepstakes at the stadium next to the car track. Due to the circumstances, the administrator of the "Favorite" Konstantin Chizhov refuses to put up with the collapse and decides to do everything to revive the team and try to win the final race of the season.
title: На вираже

overview: The Three Gentlebros depicts a chaotic relationship between a strict and controlling mother and her three sons. Pimpattra, an overbearing mother plans to set up her three sons with the women she believes to be wife materials. But things are not going as Pimpattra has planned when three women who are far from her ideal daughter-in-law come into her sons' lives. Will these non-wifey types be able to win over this domineering mother? Pimpattra is a socialite who is successful in everything except her love life. She has been in many relationships. She has three sons who were born from different fathers. Itchaya, her oldest son, is a multiracial young businessman. Mom Luang Tewit or Thames, her second son, is an heir of a noble family which owns a well-known mall. Ashira, her youngest son, is a good-looking college student. Pimpattra is planning to find perfect wives for her sons to make up for her negligence while they were growing up. However, her sons don't seem to be happy about her plan. Her goal is also hindered by women in her sons' lives. Kaewklaw is a self-supporting woman whom Itchara is interested in. Nuengnaret is a sassy woman who is working with Thames but she is Pimpattra's foe. View Nareeya is a tough young woman whom Ashira hires to obstruct his mother's plan. What will be the endings of the three brothers' romance? How will their relationship with their mother wrap up?
title: The Three GentleBros

overview: In UMG: Unidentified Mysterious Girlfriend a childhood girlfriend returns after being missing for 8 years, and there is something different about her. Mew, a boy who aspires to be an astronaut, finds his first love in Erng, his best friend. Erng, like Mew, is an odd girl with no other friends. They are always joined at the hip and do everything together, even establishing their own ‘secret base' in the woods. However, their childhood fun comes to an abrupt end when Erng vanishes without a trace. Eight years later, Mew is now a university student. He, still overcome with guilt, blames himself for Erng's disappearance. He has no social life because he is waiting for Erng to return. Jack, his childhood bully, is his only friend. One day, because of the faculty advisor, Mr. Kit, Mew and Jack join the "Mystery Exploration Club". Here, Mew meets new friends like O, a senior whose hobby is hunting monsters, and Fahsai, a beautiful girl who believes in the existence of extraterrestrial life. Mew begins to open up to new friends and the possibility of new love in this bizarre club... when, despite having been missing for 8 years, Erng suddenly reappears! The return of Erng is riddled with mysteries. Although she remembers Mew, she has no recollection of her disappearance. She also appears to have superhuman abilities. Oddities continue as 42, a mysterious alien creature, arrives in search of Erng! It's time for the Mystery Exploration Club members to band together and discover the truth. Is Erng, who reappears, the same person as Mew's first love, who vanished 8 years ago? Find out in UMG: Unidentified Mysterious Girlfriend.
title: UMG

overview: Star in My Mind portrays a romantic story of a secret admirer who spends his life by the quote "No matter which direction the earth rotates, the North Star will always shine at the same spot." Time passes, people come and go, but his love will be with the very same person, always. Daonueaonce again whirls up to meet with Khabkluen, his "first love," and the classmate he confessed to before traveling to study in Germany. However, "Have a safe flight" was the only thing he got in return for the tough confession he finally had the courage to make. Even so, this reunion makes "Daonuea" realize that no matter how much time passes, the North Star will always remain where it is. Root for this secret admirer whose mind can never be changed by the amount of time or people who enter his life. He, comparable to the North Star which always remains at the same spot, is waiting for someone to open up his heart...and let the star lead the way.
title: Star In My Mind

overview: Home School is a boarding school in the middle of a remote forest. Every three years, the school selects new students who meet their criteria, each generation comprising no more than thirteen students. The students spend a total of three years at the school. The school's meant to appeal to wealthy students with its unique curriculum and all the comforts of home. However, Home School seems more like a prison than a school with its strict rules and stark isolation.
title: Home School

overview: When a will is a cause of conflict and becomes Cupid's Last Wish, a young man whose soul gets swapped with his sister after an accident must set off a journey to get holy water from 4 temples within 7 days in order to swap back to his body. His companion to this quest is his former best friend, who is now his foe. A twist of fate has somehow tightened and mended their relationship while searching for the holy water across the country. Apart from the quest, he needs to protect his farm from the two evil relatives who wish to take all the assets of his family. Find out how the story unfolds and see if the journey can forever change their relationship. Why does the will that creates a conflict is called a Cupid's wish?
title: Cupid's Last Wish

overview: Thailand's top superstar, nicknamed "The Breath of Asia", Ton Nareubet accidentally shares a meaningful bonding night with Cake, a college student intern 20 years his junior. He mistakes her for a callgirl his best friend sends over, when in fact, Cake is just there to ask for his autograph for her mother Kanda who is a big fan. After the fateful night, Ton tries to get in touch with Cake to take responsibility by asking his nephew and manager Nadol to contact her. But believing Cake is just a social climber looking for an easy life by sleeping with celebrity, Nadol never reaches out. Things escalate when Cake's best friend, Now, out of anger on her friend's behalf, posts on her social media about a celebrity with the initial "T.N." who knocks a girl up and bails. The media is quick to pick up on the story and the whole thing turns into a big scandal. Now Ton rushes to get in touch with Cake, wanting to start over as a couple. How will this relationship with obstacles more than just age difference turn out?
title: Oops! Mr.Superstar Hit on Me

overview: My Dear Donovan will make your heart flutter with the story of a model who flies all his way to Thailand in search of his ex-lover. Unfortunately, the cupid's arrow makes him fall in love with a kind-hearted manager. Donovan, a hot American model from Palee Modeling, is in fact, in search of Maria who has come to Thailand and lost touch with him. Pam, a kindergarten teacher who is living her simple life, has been raised by her grandparents after her mother Parichat has left her to start a new life in the USA. Parichat comes back to Thailand with her new husband and her son, which makes Grandfather Poon so angry that it triggers his heart disease. He needs to undergo an expensive operation. For this reason, Pam has to work at Parichat's company, Palee Modeling, to earn money. She is assigned to work as a manager and a personal interpreter of Donovan, a hot model. Many girls have been trying to get his attention, including Jessica, a mixed-race model, and Dararai, a high-class old maid celebrity. Thus, Pam has to manage Donovan's life, both his work and his personal matters. As their relationship is growing fast, this love gets obstructed when Pam finds out the secret of Donovan. Will the love between Pam and Donovan get fulfilled in the end?
title: My Dear Donovan

overview: Alex breaks the oath he made to his mother forbidding him from losing his virginity before turning eighteen, causing chaos he never could've anticipated. Seventeen-year-old Alex lacks self-confidence and his one passion in life is photography. His household is all male, his mother having died in an accident. Before she passed, she made him promise to hold onto his virginity until the right time. However, it's nearly unbearable; his closest friends See-ew and Nim have already given up theirs, leaving only him. He, therefore, aims to lose it at Jedi's house party. School activist Jean goes to the party and it seems as though he'll lose his virginity to her. The evening turns to chaos, though, and Alex wakes up with no memory of what happened. He's aged into a man of twenty-seven: a gynecologist and sex expert. He must solve the mystery of that night and all the mess that followed using a polaroid of that night. Will he be able to return to the past?
title: The Warp Effect

overview: The Eclipse tells the story of the rule keeper who feels shaken by the rule breaker. Everything happens inside the walls of Suppalo School, the country's leading all-boys secondary school with highly strict discipline. There is even a rumor that students who break school regulations will be cursed and the curse gets more severe as a solar eclipse approaches... When there are rules, there are rule breakers. A group of students calling themselves "The World Remembers" unite with the idea that they will not follow obsolete school regulations and protest for their rights and justice. Akk, the student head prefect and the school's ideal kid, along with his fellow prefects Kanlong and Wasuwat, must constantly deal with these protesters. Then there is Ayan, a new student who seems to carry secrets with him everywhere he goes and regularly challenges the school norms. Akk, no doubt, needs to keep an eye on him. Ayan enrolls at this institution in the hopes of discovering why his uncle Dika committed suicide. His uncle's old journal, which claims the reason for his death was someone from this school, is the only evidence he has. Ayanis aware that he is being watched by Akk and always annoys him back. The two of them become close without realizing it. After spending a lot of time together, Akk develops a secret crush on Ayan but he keeps denying his feelings for this new student. However, when Ayan becomes especially close to Thuaphu, the school's top student, Akk gets jealous. Akk's crush on Ayan combines with curiosity. He notices Ayan has an old journal that he refuses to let anyone touch. Akkattempts to take the notebook in order to discover whyAyanhas joined his school and reports it to Chadok, the headmaster who instructs him to keep a close watch on Ayan. Despite the fact that all of the teachers are dissatisfied with their wayward kids, there is Sani, a visionary teacher who assists her students only from afar because she does not have enough power at school. Time passes. The students begin to doubt the curse and investigate who is causing the chaos in order to scare them away from breaching the rules. Every day, the protest becomes more intense. How will the relationship between Akk and Ayan play out? What is the truth behind the curse?
title: The Eclipse

overview: Behind every seemingly impossible marvel of modern engineering is a cast of historic trailblazers who designed new building techniques, took risks on untested materials and revolutionised their field. Brand new series, Impossible Engineering, is a tribute to their achievements. Each episode details how giant structures, record-beating buildings, war ships and space crafts are built and work. As the show revels in these modern day creations, it also leaps back in time to recount the stories of the exceptional engineers whose technological advances made it all possible. How would they have ever existed without the historical work of their ancestors? Interviews with their great advocates bring engineering history to life and retell how these incredible accomplishments shaped the modern world.
title: Impossible Engineering

overview: In an antique shop, the value of each item is the story behind them. People who sell their belongings here can reminisce on their lives, and buyers see their value hidden within. Six stories about memories, love, dreams and separation are linked to six items.
title: Good Old Days

overview: Alina Sheremeta's show features provocative themes, various formats, selected jokes and top-class irony. These are reports, discussions, travel blogs, and explainers. It's better than Wikipedia and Google.
title: Ок, Аліна

overview: Never Let Me Go follows an intense story about love that blossoms in the middle of a power struggle. Nuengdiao and his mother, Tanya, are in great danger after his father was shot to death. Palm is suddenly selected to be Nuengdiao's bodyguard. When his duty and heart are in conflict, what will Palm choose to do? How deep will the relationship between these two young men grow?
title: Never Let Me Go

overview: 10 Years Ticket tells a story of Phukao who loses his good brother at the hands of a sister he once loved with his whole heart. Phukao grows up in a family who used to own an open air cinema business. He loses his wonderful older brother forever at the hands of the sister of Kongkwan on the night of 14 February 2013, the last day of airing and his family's beloved business. That day should have been one of their fond memories to look back on. Unfortunately, it has taken an unforgettable turn and left a scar on their hearts until today. The truth is Phukao's and Kongkwan's families used to love each other like siblings, neighbors, and friends. Also, young Kongkwan is like Phukao's first love. That loss completely tears Phukao's family apart. His parents go their separate ways, while his family's financial situation becomes increasingly worse. Even though Phukao grows into a handsome, talented man who is loved and admired by everyone for his generosity, his kindness is never extended to Kongkwan and her family. Phukao hates them with all his heart. No matter how many times they move houses to escape from him, Phukao always finds and harasses them. He makes sure that Kongkwan's family remembers and never forgets that they have ruined his family and his brother's life. In 2022, Phukao and Kongkwan can no longer run from each other. Kongkwan fights her way to get into the best high school in the city, which happens to be where Phukao is studying and full of memories of their brother and sister. In this reunion, neither Phukao nor Kongkwan is willing to give in to the other. Each of them is ready to fight for their own family and older sibling. Once childhood sweethearts and now enemies, will they find their way back into love?
title: 10 Years Ticket

overview: Midnight Motel reveals the stories about teens who are making money to build up their future…but end up making trouble. The teens eagerly team up to unfold the story of night people who want to pay off their debts. They create a secret application for booking sideline girls but then accidentally get involved in a mysterious death of a businessman, the app's client, who spends a night at the hotel offering the service.
title: Midnight Motel

overview: Moonlight Chicken follows Jim and Wen who are ready to reveal their recipe of love and dish of happiness, Steamed Chicken with Rice, that will make your heart full. It tells the story of love and complicated relationships in different flavors of moods waiting to be touched and tasted.
title: Moonlight Chicken

overview: In Dirty Laundry, Neon, a lonely late-shift laundromat attendant, meets Night, a murder mystery novelist who saves her from the rampage of other customers and sweeps her off her feet. Neon falls in love with Night overnight, which brings her to his apartment where she discovers a briefcase containing one million baht. Overcome by greed, she takes the briefcase home with her and hides it at the laundromat. After Night finds out, he comes to reclaim the briefcase from Neon who gladly gives it back only to find that the briefcase is missing. The only way to identify the thief is through the log of customers who came to the laundromat. The suspects include Judo, a good-looking college student; Chompoo, Night's apartment caretaker; Momay, a sexy karaoke girl; and Nick and Smile, a rock couple. All have suspicious behavior. Who is the real culprit and how will the love story between Night and Neon turn out?
title: Dirty Laundry

overview: Vice Versa follows the adventures of Talay and Puen, who encounter bizarre scenarios. They find themselves in the bodies of strangers in a parallel universe. The only way to put a stop to this chaos is to discover the secret key that will take them back to where they came from. Talay wakes up in the body of a man named Tess. He meets Puen, a famous actor who is now in the body of Tun after an accident. Both of them have to live their lives in a new universe that is not their home, and they might even be each other's "portkeys" which can help them to return to where they came from once they have completed what they hope to achieve. The two have Phuwadol , a male nurse who helps people from the same universe they left behind, to guide them through life in this new universe. Tun and Talay have a mission to fulfill, and they are assisted by their pals Kita, Fuse, and Friend Credits members Up and Aou. Love and friendship grow with them in the new universe. What will happen with their mission? Will they be able to get back to their home universe? Stay tuned and find out together.
title: Vice Versa

overview: P.S. I Hate You is adapted from a popular novel named ‘Wongkot Dokmai' (the flower maze) by Baison. It depicts the story of love, jealousy, and viciousness of a girl friend circle and their hidden secrets. A secret tapeof Pantiwa is exposed at the wedding of hers and Pureenut. After the incident, she decides to commit suicide. Meena is trying to find the culprit who switched the wedding presentation video with her friend's sex tape. During her investigation, Meena needs to dig through the history with her ex-boyfriend, Pitch, and also discovers hidden secrets of her friends. Tidawan is having an affair with Chanon, Meena's boyfriend. Metacha is secretly filmed and blackmailed by Korawee who is the new boyfriend of Tarinee – Metacha's mother. Sarasawadee who seems to be a sweet conservative woman, is a mistress of Captain Key. She is being closely monitored by Nuttamon, Key's wife, and Lieutenant Term, Nattamon's cousin. Palana, a mysterious girl in this friend circle, may hold some secrets. It is said that living with one thousand poisonous snakes is not as scary as having untrustworthy friends. Don't forget to tune into this drama and find out how these tangled relationships unfold.
title: P.S. I Hate You

overview: Tinn is a perfect 12th-grade student body president who is gorgeous, intellectual, athletic, has a mother who works as the school principal, and is everyone's favorite. Tinn has a dream. He wants "to be with someone before finishing high school. "It might sound simple for everyone else but, for Tinn, "this is nearly mission impossible!!" The first obstacle is that Tinn's crush is Gun, the head of the music club and the main singer of the "Chinzilla" band, which has a strict rule that says "band members are not allowed to date until the Hot Wave Music Contest is over. "Gun's band members include drummer Pat, keyboardist Por, bassist Win, and sucky guitarist Yo. They aren't even skilled enough to perform in front of a broad audience, let alone compete in the Hot Wave Music Contest. The second obstacle is that this institution is highly academic. The school principal, Tinn's mother, instructs Tinn to get rid of all clubs that do not bring glory to the school, among which the music club is number one on the list. Tinn is hence Gun's "number one enemy." Meanwhile, Tinn will go to any length to keep his mother from discovering that her noble son has a crush on the head of the music club. The third obstacle is that the new guitarist at the music club Sound is incredibly skilled and attractive. He gets along great with Gun since they share a musical language. How can a love-inexperienced nerd like Tinn, who has Gun as his first love, compete with that? Though it's tough, there's nothing Tinn can't do. A year from now, he will do anything in his power as student body president to help Gun win the Hot Wave Music Contest, hoping that Gun will appreciate his effort and finally proclaim, "...My boyfriend is the school president..."
title: My School President

overview: Irin, the it girl running Bannasorn Publishing House, is crowned "the devil" for her tempestuous and fearless demeanor. But what nobody knows is that it is all an act. The truth is Irin only puts up a mean front just so her 7-year-younger little sister, Inn, could stand out more and be adored by all. But no matter how well Irin puts on such a cattish act, she can never stop her younger next-door neighbor Namchafrom falling in love with her. In fact, Irin and Namcha used to date when they were students, but for some reason, Irin broke things off without an explanation and devastated Namcha in the process. Namcha is now a veterinarian working in a hospital, and since he's never forgotten his first love, he's ready to do whatever it takes this time around to get back together with the love of his life. Since Irin won't believe he is still in love with her, Namcha makes it his mission to prove her wrong. Unfortunately for them, this second chance at love is somehow full of obstacles because Inn has also been in love with Namcha for a long time and is working with none other than their family's lawyer Jinto sabotage her sister's relationship. Jin himself, through some elaborate schemes, is working to gain the trust of both Irin and her grandfather to take care of the family. And then comes Ploychan, the owner of a dog farm who's helping Namcha and his hospital with an ulterior motive by using her dog, Action, as a go-between man. Love should come easy for the two of them, but family, work, and even friends all seem to tear them apart. How will this love be for Irin and Namcha?
title: Devil Sister

overview: Kawi, a 30-year-old young man who lives a poor life in a narrow rented room, works on subtitles every day, has no savings, no dreams, no inspiration, and most importantly, no significant other. He was one of those in his prime who had completely failed in his life, while Pearmai, who is his first love and one-sided love for over 10 years, has a happy life. She is about to marry Pisaeng, a classmate who is handsome and good-looking and was a member of the same faculty during their time in college. Kawi discovers that the musical crystal ball, an important gift he had intended to buy for Pearmai in his freshman year, has taken him back in time to his 18-year-old life, where he attempts to mend his relationship with Pearmai. With Pisaeng always hanging around, waiting to be a roadblock, everything turned upside down. Instead of being fulfilled with Pear, instead, he fell for Pisaeng.
title: Be My Favorite

overview: Kimhanmeets his college senior Nubdao again unexpectedly, but he's the only one who can remember their history. Their new relationship develops later when he starts buying every product from a home shopping show she hosts and pretends to constantly find issues with those products to get close to her. Kimhanlives the other side of his life as an artist. Afraid to reveal himself, he goes by the name Klang Mesa (Midsummer). Pete takes advantage by posing as Klang Mesa. Nubdao's best friend Nammon is a big fan of Klang Mesa. When Nammondiscovers that Peteis Klang Mesa, she falls in love with him without having any idea that he is a fake. Soon after, Min-jun, host and owner of the show Nubdao hosts, orders her character to be more bold, sassy, and sexy. Although this doesn't please Tankoon, the show's producer and Nubdao's close friend, no one cango against Min-jun's wishes. All Tankoon can do is look after and support Nubdao from afar. Meanwhile, Kimhanalso wants to cheer Nubdaoup. He disguises himself as "loong nhuad", a mystery guy who gives her advice and keeps her company via text messages. How will their relationships unfold? Stay tuned to find out!
title: Astrophile

overview: An 18-year-old soccer player who suffers a serious knee injury must give up his dream of becoming a professional player. Instead, Mads finds new meaning in forming relationships with football fans, now fighting for his club off the field.
title: Hooligan

overview: K3, een nieuw begin follows Hanne, Marthe and the brand new K3 during the first weeks after the competition and is also part of the first series of major shows in the Sportpaleis. The series also takes a unique look behind the scenes at the release of the new single, the clip recordings and the preparations for the new album.
title: K3, een nieuw begin

overview: An office drama in the fantasy genre in which Yun And So, a young girl of about twenty, starts working on an online trading platform. She will face challenges in both work and love as she finds herself in the middle of a love struggle between her first love Cha Sung Woo and her longtime friend Kwon Hyuk.
title: Heartbeat Broadcasting Accident

overview: Shen Zhengyi, a girl who has loved skating all her life, found her goal after participating in winter sports competitions. Behind her mother's back, she decides to try to enter the Zhu Feng Sports Club to become a professional short track speed skater. Due to the lack of professional training, she faces serious problems, but she still manages to get into the team. With the support of Shao Beisheng from the figure skating team, she overcomes all obstacles and wins the trust of her comrades, becoming the black horse of the competition season.
title: To Fly with You

overview: Ye Xiange is a trainee at Linshan Entertainment. Before she officially debuted, she got into a big scandal planned by her own good friend, and her company decided to terminate the contract. While unemployed, Ye Senge met the heartless CEO of Su Group, Su Men, to do an internship at his company. Then an incredible thing happened: a five-year-old boy Su Zian came to Ye Xiang and said that he was her son from the future, and his father was Su Mucheng. Ye Xiang Ge was shocked. Su Mu Chen found out about it, and he had no choice but to live with them. Based on Manhua "I'm coming! Mom, where's my dad?"
title: Please Be Married

overview: Desta Marie Beeder and her team of experts help participants who live in constant chaos and clutter get rid of half of their belongings.
title: Rydderevolusjonen

overview: Takamura Naho is an avid art collector and deputy director of Ariyoshi Art Museum, which she inherited from her grandfather. Her husband, Kazuki, is the third generation owner of Takamura Gallery, a famous gallery located in Ginza. Although Kazuki loves his wife, he is jealous of Naho who has a keen eye for arts which he doesn't have no matter how hard he tries. One day, Naho encountered a painting during her stay in Kyoto. The artist left her name "Aoba" and is an unknown painter called Shirane Itsuki who could not speak. Naho later learned from Itsuki that she is the disciple and adopted daughter of famous painter Shimura Teruyama and she has been deprived of her freedom by him for the past 17 years. While following Itsuki's arts, Naho accidentally encounters a fate-changing truth.
title: Iribito: Iribito

overview: Han Na is a female concert organizer who has an incredible secret ability: when she encounters a person whom she loves, she can "hear" their thoughts. While trying to snare a prestigious full-time job, she has a chance encounter with a man named Je Won, who has trouble expressing his feelings and suffers from a hearing-related problem. When they meet, Han Na discovers that she can read his mind, and when they are together, Je Won's hearing problems magically disappear. A romantic bond slowly develops between them. However, after they kiss for the first time, Han Na discovers that she can no longer read Je Won's mind. Will love continue to bloom for Han Na even after she stops "hearing" his innermost thoughts?
title: Mute

overview: The challenge - create a life-size house made of ...CANDY! Watch as Candy Queen Jackie Sorkin and her team of candy artists design, glue, melt and shape hundreds of thousands of sweet pieces to build a fantasy come to life….just in time for the holidays.
title: Candified: Home for the Holidays

overview: Covenant is a one-hour anthology series that transforms the stories and characters of the Bible that we know so well into a suspenseful drama - sometimes thriller - fueled by the truth of God's Word.
title: Covenant

overview: Jeopardy! National College Championship is a multiconsecutive-night event that features 36 students from 36 colleges and universities from across the country, battling head-to-head for nine days of intense competition.
title: Jeopardy! National College Championship

overview: Finding new sources of energy is a worldwide challenge. Modern societies are accustomed to citizens turning on lights at the flick of a switch, gassing up fast cars, and cheaply flying from city to city, but how will continued energy needs be met without damaging the planet? This series finds former "Mythbusters" host Kari Byron and British TV personality Dallas Campbell presenting innovators around the world who are creating new ways to power the future. Revealed are visionary large- and small-scale projects aimed at finding clean, renewable, affordable energy, and the hosts even help create a new energy installation.
title: Positive Energy

overview: Guy Fieri and his son Hunter decide to take a trip down memory lane and watch one of their favorite GGG episodes: All-Star Vegetarian Games. Hunter surprises his dad by challenging him to cook along with the challenges featured in the show. Guy gets a taste of what he puts chefs through as Hunter makes sure his dad follows all the challenge rules and sticks to the 30-minute clock. GGG judge Justin Warner joins Guy to assess his dishes, compare them to the dishes in the episode and decide if Guy is able to keep up with his own challenges.
title: Guy's Grocery Games: Guy Cooks the Games

overview: The Federation is on the brink of war with the Dominion. In the shadow of this cold war, the crew members of the USS Sally Ride must work together to not only protect the Federation, but protect it's soul as well. An epic story from the Star Trek universe that you know and love.
title: Shield of Tomorrow

overview: Trainee designer Ye Xuan dreams of working in an advertising agency, but she has not been transferred to a permanent contract for six months, and all she gets is a lot of small, featureless orders. Finally, an interesting advertising project appears, and Ye Xuan takes it up with enthusiasm to demonstrate his professional level. However, there is still a certain "side A" - its competitor. To cope with stress at work, the girl is helped by a strange neighbor Li Jinan, with whom Ye Xuan is having an affair. Who would have thought that he is the dark "side of A".
title: Party A Who Lives Beside Me

overview: A part-time chemistry romance that takes place at a restaurant with the worst chemistry of people; a girl who's never dated before but wants to flirt, a spy guy who has to stop the flirting, a girl of natural science that lives on data, a man of liberal arts who lives on emotions and others.
title: Part-Time Melo

overview: Shen Hou and Yan Xiaochen fell in love with each other at first sight. But life presents them with unpleasant surprises. Due to the death of her father and the difficulties that have arisen in the family, Xiaochen is forced to work part-time in a bar to pay for her studies at the university. One day she meets Cheng Zhiyuan, a handsome rich guy who is courting a girl, causing Shen Hou's jealousy. The lovers' wedding is canceled due to suddenly revealed family circumstances. Yan Xiaochen finds herself in a difficult situation and becomes heavily dependent on Cheng Zhiyuan, who warmly cares for his girlfriend. However, Shen Hou reappears in their lives, who reveals the innermost secret of Zhiyuan. Based on the novel of the same name by Tonghua.
title: The Memory About You

overview: A brilliant physicist with a cold, closed character and a comic book heroine with a typical Mary Sue storyline fall in love with each other. Based on Manhua GoNi ""Xin Tian Lian Ai She".
title: Heartbeat Love

overview: All the inside information, tips and tricks for how to bag a top quality Christmas without breaking the bank
title: Luxury Christmas for Less

overview: A personal tragedy causes young forensics investigator Paula to have a breakdown, which results in her admittance to a psychiatric hospital. There, she is pulled into the darkest and most terrifying corners of her mind by a mysterious doctor.
title: Insânia

overview: For 21 days, men and women - who meet naked in front of the cameras - will form pairs and will be challenged to survive in one of the most inhospitable environments in the world. No food, water or clothing. After the success of the first season of Largados e Pelados Brasil, a new group of Brazilians will have the chance to explore an extremely challenging region! They will have to overcome physical and mental challenges that increase day by day.
title: Largados e Pelados Brasil

overview: The Curse is a comedy caper set in London in the early 80's, following a gang of hopeless small time crooks who through their own stupidity and poor judgement find themselves embroiled in one of the biggest gold heists in history.
title: The Curse

overview: Set in Toronto at the dawn of the 20th century, Murdoch Mysteries is a one-hour drama series that explores the intriguing world of William Murdoch, a methodical and dashing detective who pioneers innovative forensic techniques to solve some of the city's most gruesome murders. Murdoch's colleagues include the love of his life, coroner and psychiatrist Dr. Julia Ogden, a staunch ally who shares the detective's fascination for science; Constable George Crabtree, Murdoch's eager but sometimes naïve right-hand man; Inspector Brackenreid, Murdoch's skeptical yet reluctantly supportive boss; and coroner Dr. Emily Grace, Dr. Ogden's protégé.
title: Murdoch Mysteries

overview: Lawyer by day, rapper by night. In a world ruled by men, whether rappers or lawyers, Malika goes through battles, at the office or on the radio, and traces her path as a free woman with her best weapons: her words.
title: Diana Boss

overview: Let the World See is a fresh and deep examination of Ms. Mamie Till-Mobley's fight to bring her son's body home to Chicago and her pivotal yet heartbreaking decision to have an open-casket funeral for the public to see, which ultimately served as a turning point for the civil rights movement. The docuseries also traces Ms. Mamie Till-Mobley's journey back to the Jim Crow South to face her son's murderers in court. The program will illustrate how the Till family has continued her legacy since her death in 2003, remaining active in the movement as the deaths of Trayvon Martin, George Floyd, Ms. Breonna Taylor and others sparked protests around the country.
title: Let the World See

overview: March celebrates the colorful, boisterous and competitive world of HBCU band culture through the eyes of the experts - the band members and leaders themselves. Embedded inside the Prairie View A&M University Marching Band, The Marching Storm, this engaging eight-part series will capture the blood, sweat, and tears each member sheds to make it to the field while balancing their dynamic college life.
title: March

overview: Siblings Billy Pearson, a craftsman contractor, and Carolyn Wilbrink, a designer, tackle the toughest farmhouse renovations for their clients, bringing stunning designs and customized modern conveniences to each new project.
title: Farmhouse Facelift

overview: Thieves overtake the mint of a unified Korea. With hostages trapped inside, the police must stop them — as well as the shadowy mastermind behind it all.
title: Money Heist: Korea - Joint Economic Area

overview: An investigation into the stories of some of Britain's most infamous parents.

overview: The Toys That Built America: Snack Sized is the high-speed, half-hour series that serves up the stories of the toys that shaped our history. Starting in the modern-day, then taking viewers back to the beginning, each episode focuses on the innovators, surprising facts, and cultural phenomena behind a specific iconic brand. This is everything you never knew about all the toys you know and love.
title: The Toys That Built America: Snack Sized

title: The Best of All the Smoke with Matt Barnes and Stephen Jackson

overview: Tong Xi, a ballet dancer, is forced to return from the big city to her hometown due to her mother's job transfer. She wants to hide her tough girl character by transferring to another school, but is seen through by her childhood friend, Lin Nan Yi, who knows her roots and can't get along with her. Tong Xi is acting while Li Nan Yi is trying to blow her cover. From frequent misunderstandings to mutual help, the couples gradually develop a tacit understanding and reliance on each other in their daily life with a group of small-town students. However, Tong Xi learns that Lin Nan Yi is the comic god she has admired for a long time. When the confusion in the process of finding the dreams hits the young and ignorant girl's feelings
title: Summer Again

overview: Elena devoted all her time to the family, but neither her husband nor mother appreciated her efforts. And when her younger sister, released from prison, appears in her life, it became even worse. Since childhood, spoiled, not adapted to life and dodgy, Rita decides to finally "poison" Elena's life, in every possible way setting her children against her. This turns into another tragedy and aggravates relationships in the family circle so much that the woman decides to commit suicide. It was at this moment that a stranger named Mikhail rescued her and offered a deal - to get a job at the firm of his longtime business rival. Elena agrees, not even knowing how this work will turn out for her.
title: Я заберу твою семью

overview: A Michigan couple starts up a comic book store, but when business heats up, they hire someone whose presence changes their marriage forever; a ten-year marriage falls apart when a bored wife pursues an old friend, with deadly consequences.

overview: Mike Holmes has been making it right for years, and now it's a family affair. Mike's daughter Sherry and son Michael share their own dedication and expertise as they join forces to rescue homeowners from botched construction jobs and renovation fatigue.
title: Holmes Family Rescue

overview: Ice Vikings takes viewers inside a world never before seen on television: Lake Winnipeg's commercial ice fishing industry, where descendants of Icelandic Vikings race against time and weather to bring their catch to shore before the ice gives way. These unique, brave women and men face blizzards, cracking ice and danger from every side as they use traditional ice fishing methods learned from their ancestors: Icelandic Vikings who settled near Lake Winnipeg more than 150 years ago. Ice fishing is one of the most dangerous professions in the world, in one of the most unpredictable work environments on the planet: Lake Winnipeg. With big money at stake (commercial fishing is a $25 million a year industry in Manitoba), and more than 700 people each year setting out on the ice every winter, these ice vikings put their life on the line for every fish and paycheck.
title: Ice Vikings

overview: Harry Lime is the owner/operator of Harry Lime, Inc., an international import/export organization with offices in New York City and London. Harry has an assistant, the no-nonsense, numbers-crunching accountant/associate Bradford Webster. Harry is a ladies' man, a world traveler, and a world-renowned businessman -- even though his criminal past occasionally haunts him. In contrast, Brad is strictly business: he can rattle off the projected profit of a business deal in terms of both American dollars and British pounds without the aid of an adding machine, and occasionally appears to have a negative attitude toward Harry's romantic encounters with women from around the world.
title: The Third Man

overview: Tulsa King follows New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi, just after he is released from prison after 25 years and unceremoniously exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a "crew" from a group of unlikely characters, to help him establish a new criminal empire in a place that, to him, might as well be another planet.
